scope: pinned authority trace / receive-channel presentation, not closed-loop two-way simulation

coverage.capture: Pinned native Vehicle2 drop, acceleration, steering and braking trace; judge trajectory only.

Pinned garage heightfield: sustained 54+ km/h, at least one second at 72+ km/h, washboard, crest and descent. Score vertical, tilt, trajectory and correction errors separately; surface heights do not certify wheel contact or landings.
30 s stationary on level and banked surfaces; authoritative wheel travel plus signed collider clearance.
Sampled command id, accepted input tick, predicted application tick and physical response onset; include quick opposite inputs.
Alternating ±steer, FWD/RWD/AWD, low/high grip, short/long wheelbase; capture four wheel states.
Hold/release/reapply handbrake while turning; report axle traction and applied command ids.
Confirmed takeoff/landing and signed clearance of simple colliders, including roof-first landing.
Bridge with empty space below, underpass and sloping edge; oracle clearance comes from full geometry queries.
Confirmed contact pair and impulse; angled wall, front bumper and side hits.
Two drivers plus observer, perpendicular and head-on courses; same-tick dynamic actor oracle for both clients.
Server-confirmed cannon hit, wheel topology epoch, force per wheel, post-damage steering and surviving rigid islands.
Server-confirmed impact, chunk membership epochs, body lifetime ids, missing-wheel functionality; full fracture convergence needs topology-specific oracle.
Outage during a turn; recovery trigger starts at first usable authority after link restoration, then measure sustained convergence.
Entity generation plus owner epoch; transfer while delayed input/acks from the prior driver remain queued.
Late join and interest-region exit/re-entry after wheel destruction; bootstrap/topology hashes and post-bootstrap poses.
